title: Casper and the Sigil
author: Casper Sandoval
blurb: Dominic Fairweather, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
